semiconductor_relevance: High — Semishare Co., Ltd specializes in semiconductor test equipment, particularly wafer probers, which are critical for the testing phase in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Semishare Co., Ltd provides high-performance wafer prober and semiconductor test technology solutions, serving over 1,000 universities, research institutes, and semiconductor manufacturing entities worldwide. Their offerings include standardized and customized probe station systems that cater to various testing needs from laboratories to fabs.
capabilities: Testing solutions for WAT/CP, I-V/C-V, RF/mmW, and MEMS
technical_expertise: High voltage and high current testing
